metrics.label: IP
metrics.desc: Innings pitched (outs / 3; shown as decimal innings).

metrics.label: R
metrics.desc: Runs scored while he pitched (no inherited-runner reassignment).

metrics.label: FIP
metrics.desc: Fielding-independent pitching on the RA9 scale.

metrics.label: xFIP
metrics.desc: FIP with home runs replaced by fly balls x league HR/FB.

metrics.label: Pitching+
metrics.desc: Expected run value of each pitch from stuff, location, count and sequence together (count-neutral), scaled 100 = league average, 10 = one SD of pitcher-pitch-type means.

metrics.label: Stuff+
metrics.desc: Expected run value from the pitch's physical characteristics alone (velocity, movement, spin, extension, release, arm angle, VAA, differences from his fastball), per pitch family, scaled like Pitching+.

metrics.label: Location+
metrics.desc: Expected run value of the location given count, pitch family and platoon, scaled like Pitching+.

metrics.label: xRV/100
metrics.desc: Pitching model expected runs per 100 pitches relative to the count (negative is good for the pitcher).

metrics.label: RV/100
metrics.desc: Actual run value per 100 pitches (Savant delta_run_exp, batting side: lower is better).

metrics.label: Best secondary Stuff+
metrics.desc: Highest Stuff+ among his non-fastballs thrown 5 %+ of the time.

metrics.label: Max velo
metrics.desc: Fastest pitch (95th percentile of his primary fastball).

metrics.label: Fastball arm-side run
metrics.desc: Horizontal break toward the arm side.

metrics.label: Fastball VAA
metrics.desc: Vertical approach angle at the plate (flatter = closer to 0 = harder to hit up in the zone).

metrics.label: Fastball spin efficiency
metrics.desc: Share of spin that produces movement (transverse spin over total), from the trajectory fit.

metrics.label: Fastball seam-shifted wake
metrics.desc: Gap between the observed movement direction and the measured spin axis.

metrics.label: Pitch types
metrics.desc: Pitch types thrown 5 %+ of the time.

metrics.label: FB-offspeed velo gap
metrics.desc: Primary fastball minus his slowest regular pitch.

metrics.label: Release spread
metrics.desc: SD of the release point (in): lower = more repeatable.

metrics.label: Release gap between types
metrics.desc: Largest distance between two pitch types' mean release points (tipping risk).

metrics.label: Tunnel index
metrics.desc: Separation of consecutive pitches at the plate relative to their separation at the decision point (167 ms before the plate), against the league curve; 100 = average, 10 = one SD.

metrics.label: Tunnel score (in)
metrics.desc: Plate separation beyond what the decision-point gap predicts.

metrics.label: Fastball% ahead
metrics.desc: Fastball share when ahead in the count.

metrics.label: Z-Swing%
metrics.desc: Swings at his pitches in the zone.

metrics.label: CSW%
metrics.desc: Called strikes plus whiffs per pitch.

metrics.label: Z-Contact%
metrics.desc: Contact per swing in the zone.

metrics.label: Edge%
metrics.desc: Pitches in the shadow attack zone.

metrics.label: Heart%
metrics.desc: Pitches in the heart of the zone.

metrics.label: Waste%
metrics.desc: Pitches in the waste attack zone.

metrics.label: O-Contact% allowed
metrics.desc: Contact per swing outside the zone.

metrics.label: Two-strike whiff%
metrics.desc: Whiffs per swing with two strikes.

metrics.label: Chase-band%
metrics.desc: Pitches in the chase attack zone (133-200 % of the zone).

metrics.label: BF share v LHB
metrics.desc: Share of batters faced who hit left-handed.

metrics.label: RV/100 fastballs
metrics.desc: Run value per 100 fastballs (batting side: lower is better).

metrics.label: CSW% fastballs
metrics.desc: Called strikes plus whiffs per fastballs.

metrics.label: xwOBA fastballs
metrics.desc: Savant xwOBA on PAs ending with fastballs.

metrics.label: RV/100 breaking balls
metrics.desc: Run value per 100 breaking balls (batting side: lower is better).

metrics.label: Whiff% breaking balls
metrics.desc: Whiffs per swing on breaking balls.

metrics.label: CSW% breaking balls
metrics.desc: Called strikes plus whiffs per breaking balls.

metrics.label: xwOBA breaking balls
metrics.desc: Savant xwOBA on PAs ending with breaking balls.

metrics.label: RV/100 offspeed
metrics.desc: Run value per 100 offspeed (batting side: lower is better).

metrics.label: CSW% offspeed
metrics.desc: Called strikes plus whiffs per offspeed.

metrics.label: xwOBA offspeed
metrics.desc: Savant xwOBA on PAs ending with offspeed.

metrics.label: GB%
metrics.desc: Ground balls per ball in play.

metrics.label: Pull-air% allowed
metrics.desc: Pulled line drives and fly balls.

metrics.label: xwOBA+ against (ours)
metrics.desc: Our expected wOBA allowed (see hitters' xwOBA+).

metrics.label: xwOBA+ against (park-neutral)
metrics.desc: xwOBA+ allowed in a standard park.

metrics.label: wOBA minus xwOBA+
metrics.desc: Results allowed above expectation (positive = unlucky or poor defence).

metrics.label: xRA9
metrics.desc: Expected runs per nine from xwOBA+ against (builder C's xruns over innings).

metrics.label: xwOBA 1st time through
metrics.desc: xwOBA allowed the first time through the order, shrunk with 100 PA to the league's TTO1.

metrics.label: Velo change /100 pitches
metrics.desc: Within-game fastball velocity slope per 100 pitches, shrunk to the league (mph).

metrics.label: Spin change /100 pitches
metrics.desc: Within-game fastball spin slope per 100 pitches (rpm).

metrics.label: Velo last 3 games
metrics.desc: Last three games' fastball velocity minus his season mean.

metrics.label: Spin last 3 games
metrics.desc: Last three games' spin minus his season mean.

metrics.label: Release height drift
metrics.desc: Last three games' release height minus season mean (in).

metrics.label: Velo trend /30 days
metrics.desc: Season slope of game fastball velocity per 30 days.

metrics.label: Workload flag
metrics.desc: 1 when the last three games' velocity is 1+ mph or spin 75+ rpm below his season baseline (descriptive, not medical).

metrics.label: WAR (RA9)
metrics.desc: Bullpen WAR, results-based (RA9): runs allowed against a replacement RA9 solved so pitchers share 43 % of 1,000 WAR per 2,430 games, park-adjusted, relievers scaled by (1 + gmLI) / 2.

metrics.label: WAR (xwOBA+)
metrics.desc: Bullpen WAR, regressed: expected runs from xwOBA+ against instead of runs allowed.

metrics.label: gmLI
metrics.desc: Average leverage index when entering a game (relievers).

metrics.label: RE24 saved
metrics.desc: Run expectancy saved over his PAs.

metrics.label: pLI
metrics.desc: Average leverage of the PAs he pitched.

metrics.label: Projected HR/BF
metrics.desc: Next-season home runs per batter faced.

metrics.label: Preseason projected wOBA
metrics.desc: The projection made before this season.
